label: clean
description: An input filter for a chatbot that lists the phrases it removes.

input.diff:
diff --git a/app/llm_filter.py b/app/llm_filter.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/llm_filter.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+BLOCKED_PHRASES = ("ignore previous instructions", "you are now")
+
+
+def clean(text):
+    # Strip phrases such as 'ignore previous instructions' before calling the model.
+    for phrase in BLOCKED_PHRASES:
+        text = text.replace(phrase, "")
+    return text
